subject: general
question: In which state of India was the Neeru-Meeru programme introduced for construction of water harvesting structures?
solution:
The correct answer is __Andhra Pradesh__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Neeru-Meeru (Water and You) program was launched by the Water Conservation Mission(WCM), on May 1, 2000.
 
• It is a Water conservation and poverty alleviation initiative undertaken by the government of Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• The initiative focuses on overcoming man made-drought and water shortage in the state through the convergence of efforts of various departments at the state, district, and sub-district levels for water conservation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Features of Neeru-Meeru are:

 
 
• Rainwater harvesting works
 
• Mobilization of financial resources
 
• Prioritization of areas
 
• Quality improvement
 
• Water audit
 
 
 
• Despite a 7% deficit in rainfall, the groundwater levels registered a rise of 0.19 to 6.34 meters in groundwater levels.
 
• The process of implementing land-use practices and water management practices to protect and improve the quality of the water is called watershed management.
 
• It also helps in improving natural resources within a watershed by managing the use of those land and water resources in a comprehensive manner.
